messages:
Maya R.: Quick question — anyone got lunch recs near the SF office? I'll be in from London next week and I'm vegetarian. Prefer quick spots that don't take forever.
Sam: If you're near SoMa, 'Gracias Madre' (plant-based Mexican) — quick-ish and great tacos. :taco:
Leo: +1 Gracias Madre. Also 'The Little Chihuahua' has a veggie burrito that fills you up fast.
Sofia: If you want something sit-down and tasty, 'Shizen Vegan Sushi' is amazing. A bit of a walk though.
Jules: For travel day recs (SFO arrivals) — grab a 'Boudin' clam chowder bread bowl in the airport if you want something classic. For veg: 'Curry Up Now' has stalls in terminal 3.
Maya R.: Awesome, thanks! Any coffee or pastry pick-me-ups near the office for mid-afternoon slump?
Sam: Tartine Manufactory is solid (Mission). Warm croissants. Also 'Mr. Holmes Bakehouse' for cronut vibes.
Sofia: If you have time for evening: 'Ramen Shop' (they do a good veg broth option) or 'Nopalito' for Mexican.
Leo: Also sharing a London tip since I'm there next month — near the Farringdon office try 'Dishoom' (veg options are great) and 'Koya' for quick udon.
Jules: Heathrow/Oxford St area recs: 'Honest Burgers' has a tasty veg patty and 'Roti King' near Euston is unreal after late flights.
Maya R.: Saving all these — will try Shizen and Dishoom. Any carry-on friendly snack recs for the flight?
Sam: Roasted almonds, hummus + pita snack packs, and those Oat Bars from Whole Foods. Avoid anything too smelly haha.
OpsBot: FYI — there's a team lunch next Wed at 12:30 in SF office; sign-up sheet posted in #all-hands. :spiral_calendar:
Sofia: Oops perfect timing. Can I add a +1 veg option to the lunch? I can bring a big salad.
Maya R.: Please do, thanks! Also open to any quick dinner recs close to the hotel (staying near Union Square).
Leo: If you're near Union Square, try 'Hog Island Oyster Co.' for vibes (they do sides/veg). For something super quick, 'Pick Up Stix' or 'Super Duper Burgers' are reliable.
Sam: If you want a travel-friendly dessert: Mr. Holmes donuts or a box of macarons from 'Miette'.
Maya R.: You all rock. See you next week! :wave:
